title: "Event Loading"
format: html
---

## Overview

Digital event series stores timestamped events (for example spike times, lick onsets, cue onsets).

Supported event formats:

| Format | Typical Source | Available In |
|---|---|---|
| `csv` | Event timestamp tables | Data Import Widget and JSON |
| `binary` / `uint16` | TTL bit extraction from packed words | JSON workflows |
| `hdf5` | Time array + event indicator array | JSON workflows |

::: {.callout-note}
## JSON Data Type Name
Use `"data_type": "digital_event"` in JSON.
:::

## Data Import Widget

Open **Modules -> Data Import**, choose **Digital Event Series**.

Current widget mode focuses on CSV:

- file path
- delimiter
- header toggle
- event column
- optional identifier column (to split into multiple series)

## JSON: CSV Events (`format: "csv"`)

### Single-series CSV

```json
{
  "filepath": "events/reward_times.csv",
  "data_type": "digital_event",
  "name": "reward",
  "format": "csv",
  "event_column": 0,
  "has_header": true,
  "delimiter": ","
}
```

### Multi-series CSV using identifiers

```json
{
  "filepath": "events/behavior_events.csv",
  "data_type": "digital_event",
  "name": "behavior",
  "format": "csv",
  "event_column": 1,
  "identifier_column": 0,
  "base_name": "behavior",
  "has_header": true,
  "delimiter": ","
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_column` | No | integer | `0` | 0-based event timestamp column |
| `identifier_column` | No | integer | `-1` | 0-based grouping column (`-1` disables grouping) |
| `label_column` | No | integer | - | Alias for `identifier_column` |
| `base_name` | No | string | `"events"` | Prefix used for generated series names |
| `delimiter` | No | string | `","` | Column delimiter |
| `has_header` | No | boolean | `false` | Skip first row when true |
| `scale` | No | number | `1.0` | Multiply timestamps before integer conversion |
| `scale_divide` | No | boolean | `false` | If true, divide timestamps by `scale` |
| `clock` | No | string | `"time"` | Assigns this data to an existing TimeFrame |

::: {.callout-tip}
With `identifier_column >= 0`, batch loading creates one DigitalEventSeries per unique identifier.
:::

## JSON: Binary TTL Events (`format: "binary"` or `"uint16"`)

```json
{
  "filepath": "daq/ttl.bin",
  "data_type": "digital_event",
  "name": "laser_onsets",
  "format": "binary",
  "channel": 2,
  "transition": "rising",
  "header_size": 0,
  "channel_count": 1
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | Yes | integer | - | Bit index to extract |
| `transition` | Yes | string | - | `"rising"` or `"falling"` edge events |
| `header_size` | No | integer | `0` | Bytes to skip at file start |
| `channel_count` | No | integer | `1` | Interleaved channel count in binary file |

## JSON: HDF5 Events (`format: "hdf5"`)

```json
{
  "filepath": "daq/events.h5",
  "data_type": "digital_event",
  "name": "reward",
  "format": "hdf5",
  "time_key": "time_s",
  "event_key": "reward_binary",
  "scale": 30000.0,
  "scale_divide": false
}
```

| Element | Required? | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `time_key` | Yes | string | - | Dataset path for event time values |
| `event_key` | Yes | string | - | Dataset path for 0/1 event indicator values |
| `scale` | No | number | `1.0` | Multiply (or divide) times before integer conversion |
| `scale_divide` | No | boolean | `false` | If true, divide by `scale` instead of multiply |
